subtitle: One screen for every skill on the machine, runs that never get stuck, and an agent you can put to sleep.

cards.title: Every skill, one screen
cards.text: With its logo, size and use. Install from GitHub; remove or delete in a click. Add a skill once and every Claude account can use it.

cards.title: Runs that cannot get stuck
cards.text: Commits wait for the Commit step. The run bar's current step offers Mark done, Run and End run.

cards.title: Put an agent to sleep
cards.text: From the agent menu. Idle sleep counts real work and typing, and ignores a terminal that only redraws.

cards.title: Replies fade in word by word
cards.text: A reply that arrives while the chat is open appears word by word; one you scroll back to does not replay.

also: A limit on the lists an agent may create
